supported_workflows: Fine-tuning and evaluation of aviation Q&A models on FAA material
Benchmarking question answering over Federal Aviation Regulations, AIM and PHAK
supported_questions: What actions are prohibited under 14 CFR 121.310?
What does FAR 91.213 require for inoperative equipment?
How do you read a fuel/time/distance-to-climb graph?
What are the rules for changing the address on a remote pilot certificate?

overlap_with.nature: Derived from the same FAA source corpus (Title 14 CFR, AIM, PHAK); core_rag holds raw documents, this dataset holds derived instruction/QA pairs

weak_content: Some QA pairs are highly specific to U.S. FAA rules and may not transfer to EASA or other regulators
Knowledge chunks are generic training text without structured citation beyond source field
primary_recommendation: Use as the primary evaluation/fine-tuning set for aviation domain models. For live RAG grounding, prefer aviation_faa_core_rag as the authoritative source corpus.
